execution.platform: GitHub Actions ubuntu-slim, toolchain from pinned go.mod; record CPU/OS/Go/binary/source hashes
execution.fresh_replication: second process for all Experiment tests; independent raw-evidence verifier
execution.benchmark_order: even pairs cached then direct_synthetic; odd pairs reverse
execution.analysis: per-cell paired direct-minus-cached ns/op and bytes/op; median and deterministic seeded bootstrap 95% interval (10000 resamples) for median time delta; descriptive single-runner microbenchmarks, no significance or production benefit gate
execution.budget: one 20-minute hosted job per harness revision, up to 3 revisions only for compile/harness defects; retain all failures; no threshold tuning
execution.accounting: wall spans for build, calibration, correctness, replication, every arm invocation, verifier; benchmark ns/op excludes fixture setup; no whole-task latency claim

gates.BLOCKED: build failure, missing expected tests, failed known-control, incomplete benchmark cells/pairs, missing provenance, or verifier rejection; do not promote affected claims
gates.KEEP_BOUNDED: named tests execute and pass assertions and controls; evidence packet validates; claim limited to exact tested route and fixture
gates.REVISE: an unexpected result falsifies prediction; preserve it and investigate via a separately registered follow-up, never change prediction to turn failure green
gates.KILL_BROAD_CLAIM: these experiments cannot establish end-to-end fidelity, production safety, informer elimination for all consumers, or net performance improvement

calibration: Verifier must reject zero-test green output, missing required test, missing unsafe control, and incomplete benchmark data. Existing unsafe conversion is an intentionally incorrect benign copy control, never a proposed treatment.
publication: prereg commit precedes harness execution; record tested source SHA, source base SHA, and later evidence publication SHA separately; no upstream comment sent automatically
